item.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $78,700 as Slight Hourly Dip Offsets Broader Daily Gain
item.summary: BTC/USD closed at $78,691.955 at 01:00 UTC on August 27, nearly flat over 24 hours (+0.077%) while dipping roughly 0.42% in the prior hour, as Fidelity's FBTC logged a $25.6 million daily inflow and Polymarket's venue-reported probability for an $82,500 August print stood at 33.55%.
